series.name: Initial Jobless Claims
series.description: Weekly initial claims, shown as a count.

series.description: Four-week moving average of initial claims.

series.name: Consumer Sentiment
series.description: University of Michigan index; not seasonally adjusted and delayed one month.

series.name: Effective Federal Funds Rate
series.description: Daily effective federal funds rate.

series.name: 3-Month Treasury Yield
series.description: 3-month constant-maturity yield. Filled from the Treasury par curve when FRED fails.

series.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
series.description: Benchmark 10-year constant-maturity Treasury yield. Filled from the Treasury par curve when FRED fails.

series.name: Copper / Gold
series.description: COMEX copper futures divided by gold futures.

series.name: 10Y-2Y Treasury Spread
series.description: Negative values indicate an inverted yield curve.

series.name: 10-Year Term Premium
series.description: Kim-Wright term premium on the 10-year Treasury. ACM is not published on FRED.

series.name: 10-Year Real Yield
series.description: 10-year Treasury inflation-protected yield.

series.name: S&P earnings yield minus 10Y real
series.description: Trailing S&P 500 earnings yield (Multpl monthly, estimates excluded) minus the 10-year real Treasury yield.

series.name: US M2 Money Supply
series.description: Seasonally adjusted monthly M2 level.

series.name: Fed Total Assets
series.description: Federal Reserve total assets, shown in billions.

series.name: Reserve Balances
series.description: Reserve balances with Federal Reserve Banks, shown in billions.

series.name: Overnight Reverse Repo
series.description: Treasury securities sold by the Fed in overnight reverse repo. Shown on the net liquidity card.

series.name: Treasury General Account
series.description: US Treasury general account at the Fed, week average, shown in billions.

series.name: Secured Overnight Financing Rate
series.description: Used with the interest rate on reserve balances to build the funding spread.

series.name: Interest on Reserve Balances
series.description: Used with SOFR to build the funding spread.

series.name: Chicago Fed Financial Conditions
series.description: National Financial Conditions Index. Positive values are tighter than average.

series.name: US Dollar Index
series.description: Nominal broad dollar index. Uses ICE DX-Y.NYB from Yahoo when that print is newer.

series.name: Dollar vs Advanced Economies
series.description: Nominal advanced foreign economies dollar index.

series.name: Net Liquidity
series.description: Fed assets minus the Treasury general account minus overnight reverse repo, in billions. Plotted against the S&P 500.

series.name: 2-Year minus Fed Funds
series.description: DGS2 minus the daily effective federal funds rate.

series.name: SOFR minus IORB
series.description: Secured overnight financing rate minus the interest rate on reserve balances.

series.name: Speculative positioning
series.description: CFTC leveraged-money net (long minus short) for 10-year notes, E-mini S&P 500, and the dollar index.
